units.displayText: In the Oasis' lounge

spans.text: In the Oasis' lounge

units.rawText: Angela's having a neural cloud examination today, so Shale will be telling us all a story before we go to bed! Let's give her a round of applause!
units.displayText: Angela's having a neural cloud examination today, so Shale will be telling us all a story before we go to bed! Let's give her a round of applause!

units.rawText: After I finish, the sound of clapping hands slowly fills this not-too-large room.
units.displayText: After I finish, the sound of clapping hands slowly fills this not-too-large room.

spans.text: After I finish, the sound of clapping hands slowly fills this not-too-large room.

units.rawText: Ehhh... Is Big Sis Angela okay? Will she be alright?
units.displayText: Ehhh... Is Big Sis Angela okay? Will she be alright?

spans.text: Ehhh... Is Big Sis Angela okay? Will she be alright?

units.rawText: Don't worry, it's just routine maintenance.
units.displayText: Don't worry, it's just routine maintenance.

spans.text: Don't worry, it's just routine maintenance.

units.rawText: I can't believe I've got such a large audience... Professor, is it really okay to let me handle this?
units.displayText: I can't believe I've got such a large audience... Professor, is it really okay to let me handle this?

spans.text: I can't believe I've got such a large audience... Professor, is it really okay to let me handle this?

units.rawText: Relax. Just use the same tone you have when discussing books with me, and you'll be fine.
units.displayText: Relax. Just use the same tone you have when discussing books with me, and you'll be fine.

spans.text: Relax. Just use the same tone you have when discussing books with me, and you'll be fine.

units.rawText: Yeah, feel free to ask me if there's anything you don't understand! I'll back you up from the side!
units.displayText: Yeah, feel free to ask me if there's anything you don't understand! I'll back you up from the side!

spans.text: Yeah, feel free to ask me if there's anything you don't understand! I'll back you up from the side!

units.rawText: Mhm, don't worry... That's what Miss Bunny says.
units.displayText: Mhm, don't worry... That's what Miss Bunny says.

spans.text: Mhm, don't worry... That's what Miss Bunny says.

units.rawText: Shale slowly relaxes as everyone encourages her. She clears her throat before bowing to the little Dolls before her.
units.displayText: Shale slowly relaxes as everyone encourages her. She clears her throat before bowing to the little Dolls before her.

spans.text: Shale slowly relaxes as everyone encourages her. She clears her throat before bowing to the little Dolls before her.

units.rawText: Thanks, guys. Now then, let's begin!
units.displayText: Thanks, guys. Now then, let's begin!

spans.text: Thanks, guys. Now then, let's begin!

units.rawText: ...Ahem! Long, long ago, there was a human who accidentally strayed into Hell...
units.displayText: ...Ahem! Long, long ago, there was a human who accidentally strayed into Hell...

spans.text: ...Ahem! Long, long ago, there was a human who accidentally strayed into Hell...

units.rawText: Ugh... Why is my vision clouding up...
units.displayText: Ugh... Why is my vision clouding up...

spans.text: Ugh... Why is my vision clouding up...

units.rawText: A wave of sleepiness suddenly washes over me, and my eyelids begin to close. I shake my head and repeatedly rub between my eyes to stay awake.
units.displayText: A wave of sleepiness suddenly washes over me, and my eyelids begin to close. I shake my head and repeatedly rub between my eyes to stay awake.

spans.text: A wave of sleepiness suddenly washes over me, and my eyelids begin to close. I shake my head and repeatedly rub between my eyes to stay awake.

units.rawText: Awake, awake! Tarry not in slumber!
units.displayText: Awake, awake! Tarry not in slumber!

spans.text: Awake, awake! Tarry not in slumber!

units.rawText: Strewth! If thou remain'st in Queen Mab's court, I shall cast thee from the heavens!
units.displayText: Strewth! If thou remain'st in Queen Mab's court, I shall cast thee from the heavens!

spans.text: Strewth! If thou remain'st in Queen Mab's court, I shall cast thee from the heavens!

units.rawText: The sudden sense of weightlessness banishes my sleepiness. When I open my eyes again, the scene before me is dramatically different from before.
units.displayText: The sudden sense of weightlessness banishes my sleepiness. When I open my eyes again, the scene before me is dramatically different from before.

spans.text: The sudden sense of weightlessness banishes my sleepiness. When I open my eyes again, the scene before me is dramatically different from before.

units.rawText: Where... is this place? I don't think I'm in the Oasis any more.
units.displayText: Where... is this place? I don't think I'm in the Oasis any more.

spans.text: Where... is this place? I don't think I'm in the Oasis any more.

units.rawText: Hohoho! At last, the sleeper stirs!
units.displayText: Hohoho! At last, the sleeper stirs!

spans.text: Hohoho! At last, the sleeper stirs!

units.rawText: Ready a tale for thyself; the Lady Karasu-Tengu's abode is nigh!
units.displayText: Ready a tale for thyself; the Lady Karasu-Tengu's abode is nigh!

spans.text: Ready a tale for thyself; the Lady Karasu-Tengu's abode is nigh!

units.rawText: Karasu-Tengu... Wait, who? Hang on, why am I flying through the air?!
units.displayText: Karasu-Tengu... Wait, who? Hang on, why am I flying through the air?!

spans.text: Karasu-Tengu... Wait, who? Hang on, why am I flying through the air?!

units.rawText: Humph! It is by mine hand that thou soareth! Since thou hath regained thy senses, then there is no more need to affright thee.
units.displayText: Humph! It is by mine hand that thou soareth! Since thou hath regained thy senses, then there is no more need to affright thee.

spans.text: Humph! It is by mine hand that thou soareth! Since thou hath regained thy senses, then there is no more need to affright thee.

units.rawText: The person before me hmphs before putting me back on the ground.
units.displayText: The person before me hmphs before putting me back on the ground.

spans.text: The person before me hmphs before putting me back on the ground.

units.rawText: ...Puzzle, is this some kind of new cosplay?
units.displayText: ...Puzzle, is this some kind of new cosplay?

spans.text: ...Puzzle, is this some kind of new cosplay?

units.rawText: O, me! How didst thou come to know mine title? Art thou some of diviner true names, o otherworlder?
units.displayText: O, me! How didst thou come to know mine title? Art thou some of diviner true names, o otherworlder?

spans.text: O, me! How didst thou come to know mine title? Art thou some of diviner true names, o otherworlder?
Otherworlder?
Diviner of true names?

units.rawText: Indeed, 'tis of thee I speak! Hast thou forgotten thou art an alien to this realm?
units.displayText: Indeed, 'tis of thee I speak! Hast thou forgotten thou art an alien to this realm?

spans.text: Indeed, 'tis of thee I speak! Hast thou forgotten thou art an alien to this realm?

units.rawText: Verily! How else could'st thou hath known my true name! Thou worked some manner of sorcery, did'st thou not?!
units.displayText: Verily! How else could'st thou hath known my true name! Thou worked some manner of sorcery, did'st thou not?!

spans.text: Verily! How else could'st thou hath known my true name! Thou worked some manner of sorcery, did'st thou not?!

units.rawText: Look, I have no idea what you're playing at, but I have other stuff to do...
units.displayText: Look, I have no idea what you're playing at, but I have other stuff to do...

spans.text: Look, I have no idea what you're playing at, but I have other stuff to do...

units.rawText: Upon seeing me turn around, the Puzzle-like girl suddenly spreads her wings and flaps over in front of me to block my path.
units.displayText: Upon seeing me turn around, the Puzzle-like girl suddenly spreads her wings and flaps over in front of me to block my path.

spans.text: Upon seeing me turn around, the Puzzle-like girl suddenly spreads her wings and flaps over in front of me to block my path.

units.rawText: Hoho, flight shall not be yours this day! Thou art a sacrifice for the great Karasu-Tengu, and thou may'st not leave until thy mission of rendering thy tale is discharged!
units.displayText: Hoho, flight shall not be yours this day! Thou art a sacrifice for the great Karasu-Tengu, and thou may'st not leave until thy mission of rendering thy tale is discharged!

spans.text: Hoho, flight shall not be yours this day! Thou art a sacrifice for the great Karasu-Tengu, and thou may'st not leave until thy mission of rendering thy tale is discharged!

units.rawText: Sacrifice? Rendering a tale? What are you even talking about, Puzzle...
units.displayText: Sacrifice? Rendering a tale? What are you even talking about, Puzzle...

spans.text: Sacrifice? Rendering a tale? What are you even talking about, Puzzle...

units.rawText: Also, why are you talking in such a weird way.
units.displayText: Also, why are you talking in such a weird way.

spans.text: Also, why are you talking in such a weird way.

units.rawText: Ah, I recently transmigrated back from the realm of Donadona and my speech hath not yet reverted... Ahem! It's nothing, I can switch back to normal right now!
units.displayText: Ah, I recently transmigrated back from the realm of Donadona and my speech hath not yet reverted... Ahem! It's nothing, I can switch back to normal right now!

spans.text: Ah, I recently transmigrated back from the realm of Donadona and my speech hath not yet reverted... Ahem! It's nothing, I can switch back to normal right now!

units.rawText: She flaps her wings, deliberately pointing to the horns on her head to indicate that she's different from me.
units.displayText: She flaps her wings, deliberately pointing to the horns on her head to indicate that she's different from me.

spans.text: She flaps her wings, deliberately pointing to the horns on her head to indicate that she's different from me.

units.rawText: O traveler from another world, allow me to officially introduce myself. I am Puzzle, a <color=orange>succubus</color> beholden to this infernal domain.
units.displayText: O traveler from another world, allow me to officially introduce myself. I am Puzzle, a succubus beholden to this infernal domain.

spans.text: O traveler from another world, allow me to officially introduce myself. I am Puzzle, a
succubus
beholden to this infernal domain.

units.rawText: And you, my dear sacrifice! From your attire, you should be an unfortunate human who blundered in here.
units.displayText: And you, my dear sacrifice! From your attire, you should be an unfortunate human who blundered in here.

spans.text: And you, my dear sacrifice! From your attire, you should be an unfortunate human who blundered in here.

units.rawText: There's no "should" about it, I am human... Though by the looks of things, it seems you're different from the Puzzle I know.
units.displayText: There's no "should" about it, I am human... Though by the looks of things, it seems you're different from the Puzzle I know.

spans.text: There's no "should" about it, I
am
human... Though by the looks of things, it seems you're different from the Puzzle I know.

units.rawText: So wait, according to what you just said, am I correct in understanding that I have literally gone to Hell?
units.displayText: So wait, according to what you just said, am I correct in understanding that I have literally gone to Hell?

spans.text: So wait, according to what you just said, am I correct in understanding that I have literally gone to Hell?

units.rawText: Mhm, just so!
units.displayText: Mhm, just so!

spans.text: Mhm, just so!

units.rawText: Aw, relax~ People crossing over is an everyday thing here. Humans from other worlds show up all the time.
units.displayText: Aw, relax~ People crossing over is an everyday thing here. Humans from other worlds show up all the time.

spans.text: Aw, relax~ People crossing over is an everyday thing here. Humans from other worlds show up all the time.

units.rawText: Succubus Puzzle begins counting on her fingers.
units.displayText: Succubus Puzzle begins counting on her fingers.

spans.text: Succubus Puzzle begins counting on her fingers.

units.rawText: Some of them came by way of truck, others walked out the door to visit the convenience store and stepped in here instead... There's all sorts of ways people cross over to this place!
units.displayText: Some of them came by way of truck, others walked out the door to visit the convenience store and stepped in here instead... There's all sorts of ways people cross over to this place!

spans.text: Some of them came by way of truck, others walked out the door to visit the convenience store and stepped in here instead... There's all sorts of ways people cross over to this place!

units.rawText: Also, you came just in time! Under normal circumstances, people like you would be drained dry and eaten up.
units.displayText: Also, you came just in time! Under normal circumstances, people like you would be drained dry and eaten up.

spans.text: Also, you came just in time! Under normal circumstances, people like you would be drained dry and eaten up.

units.rawText: However, there's an emergency going on right now. Lady Karasu-Tengu asked for you by name; she wants to hear about your experiences for inspiration...Humph, just rejoice at your good fortune!
units.displayText: However, there's an emergency going on right now. Lady Karasu-Tengu asked for you by name; she wants to hear about your experiences for inspiration...Humph, just rejoice at your good fortune!

spans.text: However, there's an emergency going on right now. Lady Karasu-Tengu asked for you by name; she wants to hear about your experiences for inspiration...Humph, just rejoice at your good fortune!

units.rawText: I should go.
units.displayText: I should go.

spans.text: I should go.

units.rawText: Eh? W-What are you saying?
units.displayText: Eh? W-What are you saying?

spans.text: Eh? W-What are you saying?

units.rawText: I have a world to save. Forgive me for not spending more time here.
units.displayText: I have a world to save. Forgive me for not spending more time here.

spans.text: I have a world to save. Forgive me for not spending more time here.

units.rawText: This news seems to throw the previously-serious succubus into a panic.
units.displayText: This news seems to throw the previously-serious succubus into a panic.

spans.text: This news seems to throw the previously-serious succubus into a panic.

units.rawText: You, you can't leave! Statues, seize that human!
units.displayText: You, you can't leave! Statues, seize that human!

spans.text: You, you can't leave! Statues, seize that human!

units.rawText: At Succubus-Puzzle's command, statues from all around suddenly spring to life and surround me.
units.displayText: At Succubus-Puzzle's command, statues from all around suddenly spring to life and surround me.

spans.text: At Succubus-Puzzle's command, statues from all around suddenly spring to life and surround me.

units.rawText: Hehe, how about that? Were you frightened by my golemancy?
units.displayText: Hehe, how about that? Were you frightened by my golemancy?

spans.text: Hehe, how about that? Were you frightened by my golemancy?

units.rawText: Not really. I've seen that many times in my world. Nothing to be surprised about, really.
units.displayText: Not really. I've seen that many times in my world. Nothing to be surprised about, really.

spans.text: Not really. I've seen that many times in my world. Nothing to be surprised about, really.

units.rawText: Eh? You have magic in your world too? No wait, that's impossible, right? I mean, this is a unique secret technique of mine...
units.displayText: Eh? You have magic in your world too? No wait, that's impossible, right? I mean, this is a unique secret technique of mine...

spans.text: Eh? You have magic in your world too? No wait, that's impossible, right? I mean, this is a unique secret technique of mine...

units.rawText: Ah! I've got it! You really are a cunning little sacrifice, aren't you?! You're trying to lie your way out of this because you're unhappy with the conditions, right?
units.displayText: Ah! I've got it! You really are a cunning little sacrifice, aren't you?! You're trying to lie your way out of this because you're unhappy with the conditions, right?

spans.text: Ah! I've got it! You really are a cunning little sacrifice, aren't you?! You're trying to lie your way out of this because you're unhappy with the conditions, right?

units.rawText: Then how about this; once you help us with our problems, I'll make you a personal vassal of mine and you'll get to accompany me every day.
units.displayText: Then how about this; once you help us with our problems, I'll make you a personal vassal of mine and you'll get to accompany me every day.

spans.text: Then how about this; once you help us with our problems, I'll make you a personal vassal of mine and you'll get to accompany me every day.

units.rawText: How's that? You should be satisfied, right?
units.displayText: How's that? You should be satisfied, right?

spans.text: How's that? You should be satisfied, right?
Where's the exit?
But I refuse.

units.rawText: (Sob) Awwww come ooooonnnn! Don't go! Please, help us!
units.displayText: (Sob) Awwww come ooooonnnn! Don't go! Please, help us!

spans.text: (Sob) Awwww come ooooonnnn! Don't go! Please, help us!

units.rawText: If we don't come up with a story that pleases <color=orange>Lady Mephisto</color> by today, she's going to cruelly punish us all!
units.displayText: If we don't come up with a story that pleases Lady Mephisto by today, she's going to cruelly punish us all!

spans.text: If we don't come up with a story that pleases
Lady Mephisto
by today, she's going to cruelly punish us all!

units.rawText: Succubus-Puzzle wails as she clings to my coat.
units.displayText: Succubus-Puzzle wails as she clings to my coat.

spans.text: Succubus-Puzzle wails as she clings to my coat.

units.rawText: ...Lady Mephisto? Who's that?
units.displayText: ...Lady Mephisto? Who's that?

spans.text: ...Lady Mephisto? Who's that?

units.rawText: Um, Lady Mephisto is the devil who rules Hell!
units.displayText: Um, Lady Mephisto is the devil who rules Hell!

spans.text: Um, Lady Mephisto is the devil who rules Hell!

units.rawText: Ever since she took office, she picks a random demon every month and assigns them a trial.
units.displayText: Ever since she took office, she picks a random demon every month and assigns them a trial.

spans.text: Ever since she took office, she picks a random demon every month and assigns them a trial.

units.rawText: The trial this time is to come up with a story and the demon in question is <color=orange>Lady Karasu-Tengu</color>.
units.displayText: The trial this time is to come up with a story and the demon in question is Lady Karasu-Tengu.

spans.text: The trial this time is to come up with a story and the demon in question is
Lady Karasu-Tengu

units.rawText: If Lady Karasu-Tengu can't come up with a story that satisfies Lady Mephisto, Lady Mephisto will punish everyone in Hell!
units.displayText: If Lady Karasu-Tengu can't come up with a story that satisfies Lady Mephisto, Lady Mephisto will punish everyone in Hell!

spans.text: If Lady Karasu-Tengu can't come up with a story that satisfies Lady Mephisto, Lady Mephisto will punish everyone in Hell!

units.rawText: Everyone? That seems a little unfair...
units.displayText: Everyone? That seems a little unfair...

spans.text: Everyone? That seems a little unfair...

units.rawText: That's Hell for you! Also, Lady Mephisto only cares about the results and not if they're fair or not!
units.displayText: That's Hell for you! Also, Lady Mephisto only cares about the results and not if they're fair or not!

spans.text: That's Hell for you! Also, Lady Mephisto only cares about the results and not if they're fair or not!

units.rawText: Nobody's managed to pass Lady Mephisto's trials ever since she took over... Ugh, Lady Karasu-Tengu is our last hope.
units.displayText: Nobody's managed to pass Lady Mephisto's trials ever since she took over... Ugh, Lady Karasu-Tengu is our last hope.

spans.text: Nobody's managed to pass Lady Mephisto's trials ever since she took over... Ugh, Lady Karasu-Tengu is our last hope.

units.rawText: At this point, Succubus-Puzzle shivers in terror.
units.displayText: At this point, Succubus-Puzzle shivers in terror.

spans.text: At this point, Succubus-Puzzle shivers in terror.

units.rawText: ...Come to think of it, that <color=red>Goat Succubus</color> who messed up recently ended up getting roasted over a fire.
units.displayText: ...Come to think of it, that Goat Succubus who messed up recently ended up getting roasted over a fire.

spans.text: ...Come to think of it, that
Goat Succubus
who messed up recently ended up getting roasted over a fire.

units.rawText: Do you know how evil Lady Mephisto is? In order to further degrade and humiliate that goat, she even seasoned her with cumin while she was being roasted!
units.displayText: Do you know how evil Lady Mephisto is? In order to further degrade and humiliate that goat, she even seasoned her with cumin while she was being roasted!

spans.text: Do you know how evil Lady Mephisto is? In order to further degrade and humiliate that goat, she even seasoned her with cumin while she was being roasted!

units.rawText: ...And because of that, all the demons that were originally consoling her changed their attitudes.
units.displayText: ...And because of that, all the demons that were originally consoling her changed their attitudes.

spans.text: ...And because of that, all the demons that were originally consoling her changed their attitudes.

units.rawText: They went "You smell good, bro" as they approached her with savage grins on their faces... Aiiiiieeeee! Just thinking of it frightens me!
units.displayText: They went "You smell good, bro" as they approached her with savage grins on their faces... Aiiiiieeeee! Just thinking of it frightens me!

spans.text: They went "You smell good, bro" as they approached her with savage grins on their faces... Aiiiiieeeee! Just thinking of it frightens me!

units.rawText: ...Okay that's pretty scary.
units.displayText: ...Okay that's pretty scary.

spans.text: ...Okay that's pretty scary.

units.rawText: I don't want to get roasted over a flame! So please, pleeeeeease help us!
units.displayText: I don't want to get roasted over a flame! So please, pleeeeeease help us!

spans.text: I don't want to get roasted over a flame! So please, pleeeeeease help us!

units.rawText: I don't care what you do, just inspire Lady Karasu-Tengu! C'mon, I'm begging you here!
units.displayText: I don't care what you do, just inspire Lady Karasu-Tengu! C'mon, I'm begging you here!

spans.text: I don't care what you do, just inspire Lady Karasu-Tengu! C'mon, I'm begging you here!

units.rawText: As she pleads with me, her eyes moist and full of tears, I sigh in exasperation.
units.displayText: As she pleads with me, her eyes moist and full of tears, I sigh in exasperation.

spans.text: As she pleads with me, her eyes moist and full of tears, I sigh in exasperation.

units.rawText: Lady Karasu-Tengu, I've brought the inspiration you were looking for!
units.displayText: Lady Karasu-Tengu, I've brought the inspiration you were looking for!

spans.text: Lady Karasu-Tengu, I've brought the inspiration you were looking for!

units.rawText: Er, I think you should just call me Professor...
units.displayText: Er, I think you should just call me Professor...

spans.text: Er, I think you should just call me Professor...

units.rawText: Really? So that's your little fetish, then? Hehe, alright, Professor it is!
units.displayText: Really? So that's your little fetish, then? Hehe, alright, Professor it is!

spans.text: Really? So that's your little fetish, then? Hehe, alright, Professor it is!

units.rawText: Hm? Why hasn't Lady Karasu-Tengu come out yet? Is she even at home...
units.displayText: Hm? Why hasn't Lady Karasu-Tengu come out yet? Is she even at home...

spans.text: Hm? Why hasn't Lady Karasu-Tengu come out yet? Is she even at home...

units.rawText: Nora?
units.displayText: Nora?

spans.text: Nora?

units.rawText: There you are, Lady Karasu-Tengu! Honestly, I thought you'd run off to escape your punishment!
units.displayText: There you are, Lady Karasu-Tengu! Honestly, I thought you'd run off to escape your punishment!

spans.text: There you are, Lady Karasu-Tengu! Honestly, I thought you'd run off to escape your punishment!

units.rawText: ...If only I could.
units.displayText: ...If only I could.

spans.text: ...If only I could.

units.rawText: The devil who looks like Nora sweeps her gaze across the discarded manuscripts that litter the ground.
units.displayText: The devil who looks like Nora sweeps her gaze across the discarded manuscripts that litter the ground.

spans.text: The devil who looks like Nora sweeps her gaze across the discarded manuscripts that litter the ground.

units.rawText: The deadline is nigh / Yet I lack inspiration / Mogami river.
units.displayText: The deadline is nigh / Yet I lack inspiration / Mogami river.

spans.text: The deadline is nigh / Yet I lack inspiration / Mogami river.

units.rawText: This is no time for quoting Nichijou!
units.displayText: This is no time for quoting Nichijou!

spans.text: This is no time for quoting Nichijou!

units.rawText: Inspiration... No wait, the Professor is here! I hope their experiences will give you some food for thought!
units.displayText: Inspiration... No wait, the Professor is here! I hope their experiences will give you some food for thought!

spans.text: Inspiration... No wait, the Professor is here! I hope their experiences will give you some food for thought!

units.rawText: Professor, this is the Lady Karasu-Tengu I was telling you about.
units.displayText: Professor, this is the Lady Karasu-Tengu I was telling you about.

spans.text: Professor, this is the Lady Karasu-Tengu I was telling you about.

units.rawText: Like me, she is an artistic devil! She loves writing about isekai stories and all her works sell like hotcakes down here!
units.displayText: Like me, she is an artistic devil! She loves writing about isekai stories and all her works sell like hotcakes down here!

spans.text: Like me, she is an artistic devil! She loves writing about isekai stories and all her works sell like hotcakes down here!

units.rawText: Well, if Lady Karasu-Tengu is so great, surely she won't need my help, right?
units.displayText: Well, if Lady Karasu-Tengu is so great, surely she won't need my help, right?

spans.text: Well, if Lady Karasu-Tengu is so great, surely she won't need my help, right?

units.rawText: Succubus-Puzzle looks like she's been put on the spot. She glances at Lady Karasu-Tengu; Nora nods tiredly, as though telling Puzzle to explain.
units.displayText: Succubus-Puzzle looks like she's been put on the spot. She glances at Lady Karasu-Tengu; Nora nods tiredly, as though telling Puzzle to explain.

spans.text: Succubus-Puzzle looks like she's been put on the spot. She glances at Lady Karasu-Tengu; Nora nods tiredly, as though telling Puzzle to explain.

units.rawText: ...While that's true, she shares the same flaw all us artists have.
units.displayText: ...While that's true, she shares the same flaw all us artists have.

spans.text: ...While that's true, she shares the same flaw all us artists have.

units.rawText: Simply put, she's a <color=orange>procrastinator</color>. The timeframes of her delays are measured in decades.
units.displayText: Simply put, she's a procrastinator. The timeframes of her delays are measured in decades.

spans.text: Simply put, she's a
procrastinator
. The timeframes of her delays are measured in decades.

units.rawText: In other words, she spends nine years out of every ten slacking off, then spends 11 months of that time gathering material and the final month rushing out a script before the deadline.
